title: Unit tests for payoutDebitTxId, payoutRefundTxId and payoutFeeExcessTxId (src/economy/payouts.ts)
instructions:
Add a new vitest unit test file `tests/economy/payout-tx-ids.test.ts` for `payoutDebitTxId, payoutRefundTxId and payoutFeeExcessTxId` in `src/economy/payouts.ts`.
- Read the code first (it is pasted below) and assert what it actually does; if you think the code has a bug, say so in your final answer instead of changing it.
- Use `import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";` and import the code under test with a relative path ending in `.js` (for example `../../src/economy/payouts.js`), like the other tests in this repository.
- Cover: each returns its documented prefix plus the payout id; the three ids for one payout differ; different payout ids give different tx ids; same input, same output.
